title: left parietal bone - articulations
description: Articulation record for the left parietal bone. It articulates with neighboring bones of the skull region at fibrous, cartilaginous, or synovial joints as appropriate to its location.
functions: Forms joints that permit or restrict movement.
clinical_notes: Joint injury patterns follow the local anatomy.
